## Problem

Concurrent agents need a lean local aid for idempotent checkpoints, ownership claims, send-log, and collision flags — without replacing GitHub as authority.

## What changes

- `src/jev_classifier/coord/` — SQLite `CoordStore` (checkpoints, ownership, send_log, collision_flags)
